entities.name: Scythians
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Fearsome horse archers who dominated the Eurasian steppe for 700 years. Known for elaborate gold artwork, cannabis-fueled rituals, and female warriors (the real Amazons). Even Darius I of Persia couldn't defeat them.
